description:
Query items from a DynamoDB table using key conditions.

Efficiently retrieves multiple items that share the same partition key, with optional sort key conditions.

**Returns:**
- items: Array of matching items
- count: Number of items returned
- scannedCount: Number of items evaluated (before filtering)
- lastEvaluatedKey: Key for pagination (if more results exist)

**Use cases:**
- Get all orders for a customer
- Retrieve messages in a time range
- Find products in a category with price filters
- Paginate through large result sets

**Note:** Query is more efficient than Scan. Always prefer Query when you know the partition key.

exclusiveStartKey.description: Primary key of the item to start after (for pagination)

expressionAttributeNames.description: Substitutions for reserved words in expressions. Example: {"#status": "status"}

filterExpression.description: Filter expression to apply after query. Example: "#status = :active"

indexName.description: Name of a secondary index to query instead of the main table

keyConditionExpression.description: Key condition expression. Must include partition key condition. Example: "userId = :uid" or "userId = :uid AND timestamp BETWEEN :start AND :end"

limit.description: Maximum number of items to evaluate (not necessarily return due to filters)

projectionExpression.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to retrieve. Example: "userId, name, email"

scanIndexForward.description: true for ascending order, false for descending. Default: true

name: query_items
